speaker: charlie
text: Time for some sporting excellence, and Olympic gold medallist Olivia Wunsch has been hard at work at the Australian Institute of Sport, chasing those marginal gains that could shape her Commonwealth Games and Pan Pacific campaigns. With national swim trials fast approaching, every hundredth of a second counts.

speaker: alice
text: Love seeing our athletes putting in that elite-level preparation. The AIS also announced a new partnership with Chobani to support athlete performance through evidence-based nutrition - it's all about those fine details that separate good from great. Plus Nina Kennedy just secured her fifth national pole vault title and her spot on the Commonwealth Games team.

speaker: charlie
text: And looking ahead to some massive sporting events, State of Origin Game One is coming up on May 27th at Accor Stadium, followed by Magic Round at Suncorp Stadium from May 14-17. Nothing like Queensland rugby league to get the blood pumping - though let's be honest, NSW might actually put up a fight this year.
